title: 第一卷 第76章 异域美人！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他现在也看出来了，这兽灵王星是火焰王星，不是一般人能拿得到的。

巨血剑与红毛怪的两只爪子激烈的碰撞，红毛怪终于发出了一声吃痛的叫声，身体被巨血剑劈得急速后退，而与此同时，武归云的身体也如同流星倒飞出去。

我看着看热闹的人越来越多，就道：“苏老师，我们回学校吧，要晚上。疯子什么的不要理会。”说完带头走向学校之中。

贺之洲正与安康说着住客栈的安全巡视问题，冷不防明月一下挣脱他的手，他忙转头去看，就瞧见明月凶悍的扇打娉婷公主这一画面。

可惜那些个赵军不是固守不出，就是被打了个措手不及，溃散而逃，倒是有那么几个够胆量的羯人见着慕容泫，就来占便宜，结果害的她背上伤了一块。

而刚才的那些黑衣人在化为本体后已经大变样，若说之前还是人，这会儿基本只剩下骨骼了，看得让人十分的震惊和惊骇。

贺之洲那样的人，怎么可能放低身段跟他解释什么当年他才六岁什么的，这分明就是在拖延时间，等到之前撤走的守卫过来，这少年肯定再也走不掉了。

虽然赫尊不让赵仁凡过去，但是赵仁凡还是要想一些办法帮忙的。

有人要对他下手，斩草除根，他逃亡外海，过上了隐居的生活，消失了万年之久，直到当年他的仇人在一次秘境探险中身殒，他才重新出现。

“只要她还在大梁，就总有找到她的一天。”贺之洲摸摸明月的头顶心，沉声说道。

可以说，这是一场没有悬念的战斗，此时的魔族第六军团，优势已经完全消失，就算是副将也是惨死了两人，可谓是损失惨重。

青年呆住了，看着妹妹空洞的眼眶，僵硬的表情。突然的他笑了，笑的眼泪不住的往下流。

魔焰风暴狠狠打在了凌天的身前，与此同时，炎魔的嘴角，就是勾起了一抹笑意。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He can now see that this Beast Spirit King is the Flame King, which cannot be obtained by ordinary people.

The giant blood sword collided fiercely with the two claws of the red-haired monster. The red-haired monster finally let out a cry of pain, and his body was slashed back by the giant blood sword. At the same time, Wu Guiyun's body flew backwards like a meteor.

I saw more and more people watching the excitement, so I said, "Teacher Su, let's go back to school at night. Ignore crazy people or anything like that." After that, I took the lead and walked into the school.

He Zhizhou was talking to Ankang about the safety inspection of the inn when Mingyue suddenly broke away from his hand. He quickly turned around and saw Mingyue beating Princess Pingting fiercely.

It's a pity that those Zhao soldiers either couldn't stand or were caught off guard and fled. However, there were a few brave Jie people who came to take advantage of Murong Xun when they saw her. As a result, she suffered a bruise on her back.

The men in black just now have changed drastically after turning into their own bodies. If they were still humans before, now they are basically just skeletons, which is very shocking and horrifying to see.

How could a person like He Zhizhou lower himself and explain to him that he was only six years old? This was obviously delaying time. When the guards who had previously withdrawn came, the boy would definitely not be able to leave again.

Although Hezun wouldn't let Zhao Renfan pass, Zhao Renfan still had to think of some ways to help.

Someone wanted to attack him and eradicate the roots. He fled to the sea and lived a secluded life. He disappeared for thousands of years. It was not until his enemy died during an adventure in a secret realm that he reappeared.

"As long as she is still in Daliang, there will always be a day when she will be found." He Zhizhou touched the center of Mingyue's head and said in a deep voice.

It can be said that this is a battle without suspense. At this time, the advantage of the Sixth Demon Legion has completely disappeared. Even the deputy generals died tragically, which can be said to be a heavy loss.

The young man was stunned, looking at his sister's empty eyes and stiff expression.Suddenly he laughed, tears streaming down his face.

The demonic flame storm hit Ling Tian hard in front of him, and at the same time, the corner of Yan Mo's mouth curled up into a smile.
